system.description: You’ve trained your body to restore and reset itself in a shorter burst of self-healing via intense training and focus. On your turn, by spending 1 Discipline and a Bonus action, you regain hit points equal to 1 Flurry Die. This increases to 2 Flurry Die at 9th and 3 Flurry Die at 15th. Once you use this feature you cannot use it again until the end of your next turn. Additionally, you cannot regain hit points in this way outside of combat as your body requires adrenaline for this to function.
